from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
root=Path('/workspace/-MGAR-v2-')
values=dict(line.split('=',1) for line in (root/'.local/db.env').read_text().splitlines())
secret=values['MGAR_TEST_DB_PASSWORD'].encode()
names=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-z','-co','--exclude-standard'],cwd=root).split(b'\0'))-{b''}
for name in names:
 p=root/name.decode()
 if p.is_file() and secret in p.read_bytes():
  raise SystemExit('local credential leaked to a Git candidate; content withheld')
r=subprocess.run(['/workspace/.mgar-tools/go/bin/gofmt','-l','cmd','internal','tests','migrations'],cwd=root,text=True,capture_output=True)
if r.returncode or r.stdout:
 raise SystemExit('Go files require formatting: '+r.stdout)
print('Known local credential absent from '+str(len(names))+' Git candidates; all Go files formatted.')
